note: Accessibility coverage census for every component under src/design (C-13). A component is either mounted in an axe guard or carries a NAMED reason it is not - there is no third state, and 'nobody got round to it' is not a reason, it is the unrostered bucket. Buckets: 'rostered' = a case in a11y-axe-guard.test.tsx; 'rostered:shell' = a case in a11y-axe-shell.test.tsx (the Tauri-mocked chrome); 'no-dom:' = emits no DOM node at all; 'aria-hidden:' = mounted inside aria-hidden, so assistive tech never reaches it; 'unrostered:' = recorded debt, capped by unrosteredCeiling below. Same shape and same purpose as mono-census.baseline.json: re-classify any entry you verify - that is the point of the file. Seeded 2026-08-19 from the mounts each component actually has in the app.

components.src/design/with-terms.tsx: no-dom: a function, not a component; the Term triggers it returns are axe-checked in the withTerms roster case
components.src/design/console/ReticleCursor.tsx: aria-hidden: decorative pointer reticle, mounted aria-hidden="true" and stood down under reduced motion / coarse pointer — AT never reaches it
components.src/design/jarvis/LenisSpine.tsx: no-dom: effect-only smooth-scroll spine — returns null, contributes no node for AT to meet
components.src/design/jarvis/MagneticLayer.tsx: no-dom: effect-only cursor-magnetism layer — returns null, contributes no node for AT to meet
components.src/design/vendor/HolographicMaterial/Ho: no-dom: a three.js shader material — it renders into a WebGL canvas and emits no DOM at all
components.src/design/vendor/Stepper/Stepper.tsx: aria-hidden: SetupTour mounts StepIndicator/StepConnector inside aria-hidden="true" — pointer affordance only, since keyboard and AT users drive the tour with Back/Next. Rostering it would measure a shape the app never presents
